name: react-monorepo-ai
description: React + React Native monorepo template built for AI-agent-authored development

scripts.//fix: eslint --fix and prettier --write are SEPARATE steps: Prettier is not run as a lint rule (eslint-plugin-prettier is materially slower across a monorepo), so `lint:fix` alone leaves formatting untouched. Use this after generating code.
scripts.doctor: node scripts/assert-single-version.mjs && pnpm --filter @repo/mobile run doctor && pnpm --filter @repo/mobile exec expo install --check
scripts.quality:check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:coverage && node scripts/assert-single-version.mjs

//lint-staged: --no-warn-ignored is REQUIRED, not cosmetic: lint-staged passes explicit file paths, and ESLint warns once per explicitly-passed file that a config ignores (every *.config.js, mockServiceWorker.js, …). With --max-warnings=0 those warnings alone fail the hook, so the flag is what keeps the strict gate usable.
